_comment: Fine-tuning data, written for this demo from help_center.json. Every answer comes from the article named in 'article'; prepare_data.py adds the line 'Source: <article title>' to each answer. 'twin' marks the training question that covers the same fact as a test question (test_questions.json); the test questions themselves never appear here. 'decline' examples are out-of-scope questions (different from the test set's) that should get the decline message. 'valid' examples are only used to watch the validation loss during training.
decline_answer: I don't have that information in our help center. Our support team is available 24/7 via live chat.

train.question: How do I create my first project?
train.answer: Click New Project in the top-right corner of the dashboard and give the project a name.

train.question: Do I need a credit card to try the product?
train.answer: No. Every new organization starts with a 14-day free trial of the Pro plan, and no credit card is required.

train.question: What should I do first after signing up?
train.answer: Create a project with New Project, invite teammates, import your existing tasks, and connect Slack. The checklist on the dashboard walks you through these steps.

train.question: What does the Basic plan cost?
train.answer: The Basic plan costs $10 per month and includes 3 projects.

train.question: What's the monthly price of Pro?
train.answer: The Pro plan costs $25 per month and includes unlimited projects.

train.question: How many projects come with the Basic plan?
train.answer: The Basic plan includes 3 projects. The Pro plan includes unlimited projects.

train.question: How many days does the Pro trial last?
train.answer: The Pro trial lasts 14 days and includes every Pro feature.

train.question: What happens when my trial ends?
train.answer: If you don't upgrade, the organization moves to the Basic plan. Nothing is deleted, but projects beyond the Basic limit of 3 become read-only until you upgrade or archive them.

train.question: Can I start a second free trial?
train.answer: No. Each organization can start one trial, and creating a second organization to extend a trial is not allowed.

train.question: How do I upgrade to Pro?
train.answer: Go to Settings > Billing > Change plan. Upgrades take effect immediately, and you are charged a prorated amount for the rest of the billing period.

train.question: When does a downgrade take effect?
train.answer: Downgrades take effect at the start of the next billing period, so you keep Pro features until then. On an annual plan, a downgrade takes effect when the annual period ends.

train.question: What do I need to do before downgrading to Basic?
train.answer: Archive projects until no more than 3 are active, and remove members until no more than 5 remain. Only the Owner can change the plan.

train.question: How much is Pro if I pay yearly?
train.answer: Pro costs $250 per year on annual billing, the same as 10 months of monthly billing.

train.question: What does Basic cost per year?
train.answer: Basic costs $100 per year on annual billing.

train.question: Do annual plans renew automatically?
train.answer: Yes. Annual plans renew automatically on the anniversary of the purchase date, and the Owner gets a reminder email 14 days before each renewal.

train.question: Which credit cards do you accept?
train.answer: We accept Visa, Mastercard, and American Express.

train.question: Do you accept PayPal or crypto?
train.answer: No. We do not accept PayPal or cryptocurrency.

train.question: Can we pay by bank transfer?
train.answer: Yes, if your organization is on an annual plan. Ask for invoice payment through live chat before your first annual payment.

train.question: Where can I download my invoices?
train.answer: All invoices are under Settings > Billing > Invoices, where you can download each one as a PDF.

train.question: How do I add our VAT number to invoices?
train.answer: Edit Settings > Billing > Invoice details. The change applies to invoices issued after you save it.

train.question: Can you fix the address on an old invoice?
train.answer: Past invoices can't be edited. Email billing@example.com if one needs to be reissued with corrected details.

train.question: Who do I contact about a billing problem?
train.answer: Contact our accounting department at billing@example.com.

train.question: What's the email address for billing questions?
train.answer: Billing issues can be resolved by contacting our accounting department at billing@example.com.

train.question: My card was declined. What happens now?
train.answer: We retry the card 3 times over 7 days and email the account owner after each attempt. If every retry fails, the organization becomes read-only until the payment method is updated.

train.question: Is my data deleted if a payment fails?
train.answer: No. No data is deleted while an organization is read-only. Update the payment method under Settings > Billing > Payment method to unlock it.

train.question: What can members do while the organization is read-only?
train.answer: They can sign in and view everything, but nobody can create or edit tasks.

train.question: Can I get a refund?
train.answer: Yes. Customers can request a refund within 30 days of purchase.

train.question: Where does a refund go?
train.answer: Approved refunds are returned to the original payment method.

train.question: How do I cancel my subscription?
train.answer: Go to Settings > Billing > Cancel. Your plan stays active until the end of the current billing period.

train.question: Does my plan stop immediately when I cancel?
train.answer: No. Your plan stays active until the end of the current billing period.

train.question: What happens to my data when my plan ends?
train.answer: Your data is kept for 90 days. After 90 days, all projects, tasks, and files are permanently deleted.

train.question: Can I still export after my plan ends?
train.answer: Yes. For 90 days after your plan ends, you can still sign in, export your data, and reactivate your subscription.

train.question: Can I reactivate my old account?
train.answer: Yes, within 90 days after your plan ends. Reactivate from Settings > Billing, and everything will be exactly as you left it.

train.question: How do I delete our organization?
train.answer: The account owner can delete it from Settings > Organization > Delete organization. Deletion is permanent and is completed within 24 hours.

train.question: Does deleting the organization cancel the subscription?
train.answer: Yes. An active subscription is cancelled automatically when the organization is deleted.

train.question: I forgot my password. What do I do?
train.answer: Click 'Forgot Password' on the login page. The reset link expires after 1 hour.

train.question: When does the password reset email link expire?
train.answer: The reset link expires after 1 hour.

train.question: How do I turn on two-factor authentication?
train.answer: Enable it under Settings > Security. We support authenticator apps.

train.question: Can I get two-factor codes by SMS?
train.answer: No. SMS codes are not supported; use an authenticator app.

train.question: Which plans include SSO?
train.answer: Single sign-on is available on the Pro plan. SSO is not available on the Basic plan.

train.question: Which identity providers work with your SSO?
train.answer: Any SAML 2.0 identity provider, such as Okta or Microsoft Entra ID. Configure it under Settings > Security > SSO.

train.question: Can the Owner still use a password when SSO is enforced?
train.answer: Yes. The Owner can always sign in with a password, so a misconfigured identity provider can't lock everyone out.

train.question: How do I change my login email?
train.answer: Go to Profile > Account > Email. We send a confirmation link to the new address, and the change takes effect only after you click it.

train.question: How long is the email confirmation link valid?
train.answer: The confirmation link expires after 24 hours. If it expires, start the change again.

train.question: Why is my account locked?
train.answer: After 10 failed sign-in attempts in a row, an account is locked for 30 minutes. Wait, or reset your password to unlock it immediately.

train.question: Can support unlock my account?
train.answer: No. Support can't unlock accounts manually. Wait 30 minutes or reset your password.

train.question: What is the member limit on Basic?
train.answer: The Basic plan includes up to 5 members. The Pro plan has no member limit.

train.question: When do invitations expire?
train.answer: Invitations expire after 7 days. You can resend an expired invitation from Settings > Members > Invite.

train.question: How do I invite a coworker?
train.answer: Go to Settings > Members > Invite, enter their email address, and choose a role.

train.question: Can I give a client access to one project?
train.answer: Yes. Invite them as a guest from the project's Members tab. Guests can view the project, comment, and edit tasks assigned to them.

train.question: Do guests count toward the member limit?
train.answer: No. Guests don't count toward your plan's member limit.

train.question: What roles can members have?
train.answer: Every member is an Owner, Admin, or Member. Each organization has exactly one Owner.

train.question: Who can delete our organization?
train.answer: Only the Owner can delete the organization.

train.question: What can Admins do?
train.answer: Admins can invite and remove members and change project settings.

train.question: How do I make someone else the Owner?
train.answer: The current Owner can transfer ownership from Settings > Organization > Transfer ownership. The new Owner must already be an Admin.

train.question: What happens to the old Owner after a transfer?
train.answer: The previous Owner becomes an Admin, and billing emails go to the new Owner.

train.question: What happens to a removed member's tasks?
train.answer: The work they created stays in its projects, and tasks assigned to them become unassigned.

train.question: How do I remove someone from the organization?
train.answer: An Admin can remove a member from Settings > Members. The member loses access immediately.

train.question: How do I create a task quickly?
train.answer: Press N, or use the New Task button in any project.

train.question: How many custom statuses can a project have?
train.answer: Admins can add up to 10 custom statuses per project.

train.question: When is a task with subtasks shown as complete?
train.answer: Only when all its subtasks are done.

train.question: When do I get reminded about a task that's due?
train.answer: The assignee gets a reminder email the morning a task is due.

train.question: Which time zone do due dates use?
train.answer: Due dates use the time zone set in your profile.

train.question: Can tasks repeat every week?
train.answer: Yes. Choose Repeat from the task's due date menu; tasks can repeat daily, weekly, monthly, or on a custom schedule.

train.question: Are comments copied to the next recurring task?
train.answer: No. Comments and attachments are not copied to the next task.

train.question: How do I mention a teammate?
train.answer: Type @ followed by their name in a comment. They get a notification.

train.question: How long can I edit my comment?
train.answer: You can edit or delete your own comments for 24 hours after posting them.

train.question: Does search look inside PDF attachments?
train.answer: No. Text inside attached files is not searched; search covers task titles, descriptions, comments, and attached file names.

train.question: How do I open search?
train.answer: Press / from anywhere in the app.

train.question: Are labels shared between projects?
train.answer: No. Labels belong to a project, so each project has its own set.

train.question: What does a project template include?
train.answer: A template keeps the project's statuses, labels, and tasks, but not its members, comments, or attachments.

train.question: How do I save a project as a template?
train.answer: Open the project's Settings tab and choose Save as template.

train.question: Is the Reports page on the Basic plan?
train.answer: No. Reports are available on the Pro plan.

train.question: How often are reports updated?
train.answer: Reports are updated every hour.

train.question: Do archived projects count toward the project limit?
train.answer: No. Archived projects are read-only and don't count toward your plan's project limit.

train.question: Can I restore an archived project?
train.answer: Yes, at any time, from the Archived section of the project list.

train.question: I deleted a task yesterday. Can I restore it?
train.answer: Yes. Deleted items stay in Trash for 30 days. Restore it from Trash in the sidebar.

train.question: How long do deleted items stay in Trash?
train.answer: Deleted tasks, files, and projects stay in Trash for 30 days.

train.question: Who can restore a deleted project?
train.answer: Only Admins can restore a deleted project.

train.question: Can support recover items deleted more than 30 days ago?
train.answer: No. After 30 days, items are permanently deleted and cannot be recovered, even by support.

train.question: What's the maximum attachment size on Pro?
train.answer: The maximum file size is 2 GB on Pro and 100 MB on Basic.

train.question: How much storage does Basic include?
train.answer: Each organization gets 10 GB of storage on Basic and 1 TB on Pro.

train.question: What happens when we run out of storage?
train.answer: New uploads are blocked until files are deleted or the plan is upgraded.

train.question: How do I export my data?
train.answer: Export your data as CSV from Settings > Data > Export. Exports include all projects and are emailed to the account owner.

train.question: Who receives the data export?
train.answer: Exports are emailed to the account owner.

train.question: Can I import tasks from a CSV file?
train.answer: Yes. Import tasks from a CSV file under Settings > Data > Import. The file needs a header row with at least a Title column.

train.question: How many rows can one import have?
train.answer: Each import is limited to 10,000 rows.

train.question: Can I import directly from another project-management tool?
train.answer: No. Direct imports from other project-management tools are not supported; use a CSV file.

train.question: Where do I create an API key?
train.answer: Under Settings > Developer > API keys.

train.question: Do API keys expire?
train.answer: No. A key works until it is revoked, or until the member who created it is removed from the organization.

train.question: What is the API rate limit on Pro?
train.answer: 1,000 requests per minute per key on Pro, and 100 per minute per key on Basic.

train.question: What happens if I go over the rate limit?
train.answer: Requests over the limit receive HTTP status 429 with a Retry-After header that gives the number of seconds to wait.

train.question: How are webhooks signed?
train.answer: Each request is signed with HMAC-SHA256 using your webhook secret, and the signature is sent in the X-Signature header.

train.question: What if my webhook endpoint is down?
train.answer: Failed deliveries are retried up to 5 times over 24 hours, after which the webhook is paused and the Owner is notified by email.

train.question: Which tools do you integrate with?
train.answer: Slack, Google Drive, and GitHub. Connect them under Settings > Integrations.

train.question: How does the GitHub integration link pull requests?
train.answer: GitHub links a pull request to a task when the task ID appears in the branch name, and the task moves to Done when the pull request is merged.

train.question: Can I get one summary email per day?
train.answer: Yes. Under Profile > Notifications you can switch to a daily summary sent at 8:00 in your time zone.

train.question: Do you have an iPhone app?
train.answer: Yes. Our iOS and Android apps are free on both plans.

train.question: Can I change billing in the mobile app?
train.answer: No. Project settings, billing, and imports are only available on the web.

train.question: Does the app work offline?
train.answer: The web app needs an internet connection. The mobile apps let you read and edit recent projects offline, and changes sync when you reconnect.

train.question: Which browsers are supported?
train.answer: The latest two versions of Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and Edge. Internet Explorer is not supported.

train.question: Which languages is the app available in?
train.answer: English, German, French, and Spanish.

train.question: Where do I change my time zone?
train.answer: Under Profile > Account.

train.question: Can I change my organization's data region?
train.answer: No. You choose the region when you create the organization, and it can't be changed later. To use a different region, create a new organization there and move your data with an export and an import.

train.question: Where is our data stored?
train.answer: In the European Union (Frankfurt) or the United States (Virginia), depending on the region chosen when the organization was created.

train.question: Is my data encrypted?
train.answer: Yes. Data is encrypted in transit with TLS 1.2 or later and at rest with AES-256.

train.question: Can I get your security audit report?
train.answer: Pro customers can request the latest report through live chat.

train.question: When is your maintenance window?
train.answer: Scheduled maintenance takes place on Sundays between 02:00 and 04:00 UTC and is announced at least 48 hours in advance.

train.question: Where can I check if the service is down?
train.answer: Check status.example.com for current incidents and scheduled maintenance.

train.question: How do I see all keyboard shortcuts?
train.answer: Press ? anywhere in the app.

train.question: When is support available?
train.answer: Our support team is available 24/7 via live chat.

train.question: How do I reach support?
train.answer: Through live chat, 24/7.
